[IRET.7.3] `hash` is the XOR-rotation hash of the fact
IDs in the token. It is used as the O(1) pre-filter for
duplicate detection and refraction table lookups; it is
not the key. Hash collisions are disambiguated by token
identity — `tokens_equal` (pointer / fact-id equality)
for duplicate detection, and the fact-id tuple for
refraction (`[IRET.11.3]`).
